summary: BatchChecker v0 live: step UI, New to this? tour, phone cards, CSV, 6s timeout/retry, public test-runs page with short clips. Testnet default + Mainnet toggle. Wired into Analyst Starter / Projects Live / All tools. forceNodeDown test hook removed. More info mentions CSV for own records at tax time (education; not advice).
security: No keys/seeds; secret-looking input cleared and never sent
No localStorage/sessionStorage of addresses (consent.js still only stores terms version); tour stores nothing
No analytics; CSP connect-src limited to known public XRPL WSS; media-src 'self' on batch + tests
Test-only forceNodeDown hook removed before release
SPDX Apache-2.0 on batch-checker.js; site LICENSE already Apache-2.0 (Lobby not relicensed)
risks: Single page CSP allows both Testnet and Mainnet WSS (unlike per-network Balance Checker pages)
Public nodes may rate-limit; sequential delay may still fail under load
account_tx last-activity shape can vary by node (close_time_iso vs date)
